note_en: 不管是 A，还是 B means "whether A or B, …": whichever case it is, the outcome stays the same. In the text: 不管是加班到深夜，还是周末懒得下床，她的晚饭几乎都是从这个软件里来的 "whether she's working late into the night or too lazy to get out of bed on the weekend, her dinner almost always comes from this app." The second half usually has 都 or 也 (or 永远, as in 饭桌上永远有一碗热汤) to show the result doesn't change.
